answer: To resist sybil attacks, tie payout and vote weight to a slowly maturing identity bond rather than headcount. Each new alias must lock a non-transferable walnut of collateral that ripens only after an observation window, when withdrawals travel a delayed settlement river and cannot fund fresh names. Slash penalties follow a velvet curve, so correlated clones lose a steepening fraction and a farm never recovers the cost of one honest identity. Attestation rights then scale with vested age and unique work, not key count.
